assets.method: OpenAI built-in image generation, descriptive prompt only
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a premium transparent-background decorative illustration for the Rangoon AI capability workbench, used alongside crisp vector UI icons. Primary request: a beautifully crafted abstract capability assembly, an orange folded origami core built from two interlocking triangular wings, surrounded by three small modular rounded-square nodes connected with delicate brushed-metal rails. The core's folds echo a rangoon dumpling and the warm orange origami identity. No face, no lettering, no wordmark, no replacement app logo. Composition: single compact centered object, three-quarter isometric view, plenty of clean transparent margin; intended to sit in the right side of a dark or light dashboard hero at 320px wide. Materials: rich amber-orange anodized metal and softly translucent orange glass edge insets, small ivory ceramic nodes, restrained graphite metal detail. Lighting: refined studio product render, soft realistic ambient occlusion only immediately under the object, crisp silhouette, controlled warm highlights, tasteful detail visible at medium size. Overall feel: premium desktop software, tactile and precise, beautifully art-directed, elegant and confident. Background truly transparent. Avoid words, numbers, grids, UI screenshots, badges, check marks, shields, padlocks, currency, neon cyberpunk effects, sprawling cables, excessive glow, floor/background planes, watermark, or any implication of a real running/authorized system.
